native_framing.supports: Two consecutive typed blend_support_surface/plane descriptions, bounded fixed-width fields and absent optional curves, preserved without reconstructing the exact blend.
native_framing.chord_spine: Bounded embedded degree-five exact_int_cur NUBS subtype; complete cache is parsed by the existing exact-curve reader, then one fixed_width description.
native_framing.asymmetric_spine: Explicit straight description with finite bounds, then two edge_offset descriptions.
native_framing.grid: Explicit nurbs/degree3/degree3/both marker and four enum0 flags; counted U/V compact knots; four doubles per rational control; U-fast to V-fast normalization.
native_framing.trailer: Scalar, six counted scalar lists, literal boolean/integer fields, null_curve, literal flags, nullbs/nullbs, exact subtype end, four finite bounds, exact record exhaustion.

limitations: API truth captured Fillet settings, not surface-cache or evaluator getters. No exact procedural surface or approximation-error bound is claimed.
The two observed support/spine/mode combinations are bounded independently. Other support types, rational weights layouts, wrapper variants and procedural blend types remain unsupported.
Surface and XYZ/UV caches can disagree at interior samples. Values are reported as corroboration of stored approximations, not exact curve/surface equality.
Edge32 has negative XYZ parameter bounds but positive UV-cache bounds with opposite endpoint order. Parameter correspondence and flag semantics remain unresolved; no automatic remapping is applied.
Endpoint set agreement is checked only after explicit coedge/loop/face and edge/vertex/point identity links. Geometry is never used to choose persistent identities or owners.
Raw ASM coordinates are retained; current visibility, lifecycle, assembly solving, placement and regeneration are unresolved.
